raw.query: WITH current_eda AS (SELECT e.metric_path,e.value_num,e.window_bin,d.is_current,d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.eda_metric e ON e.run_id=d.run_id WHERE d.run_id='eda:a_quality' AND d.is_current=true), slope AS (SELECT MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path='median_context_vs_images_slope_tokens_per_image') AS traced_slope,MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path='median_context_vs_images_intercept') AS intercept,COUNT(DISTINCT window_bin) FILTER (WHERE metric_path LIKE 'median_context_vs_images%') AS slope_window_breakdowns,BOOL_AND(is_current) AS is_current,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS superseded_rows FROM current_eda WHERE metric_path LIKE 'median_context_vs_images%'), image_breakdown AS (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(metric_path,value_num ORDER BY metric_path) AS selected_denominator_breakdown FROM current_eda WHERE metric_path ~ '^context_tokens_by_numimages\.(0|1|4|9|16|25|36|49|64|81|100)\.(count|median)$'), encoder AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS function_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT source_path) AS source_artifacts,COUNT(DISTINCT b.model_dir) AS model_dirs,MIN(f.image_px) AS min_image_px,MAX(f.image_px) AS max_image_px,MIN(f.patches::numeric/f.n_images) AS min_patches_per_image,MAX(f.patches::numeric/f.n_images) AS max_patches_per_image,MIN(f.post_merge_tokens::numeric/f.n_images) AS min_post_merge_tokens_per_image,MAX(f.post_merge_tokens::numeric/f.n_images) AS max_post_merge_tokens_per_image,BOOL_AND(f.is_valid AND b.is_valid) AS all_valid,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.raw::text LIKE '%4096%' OR b.raw::text LIKE '%4096%') AS rows_backing_4096 FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn f JOIN provenance.collector_bench_run b USING (source_path) WHERE f.post_merge_tokens IS NOT NULL AND b.family='anchor'), owner_status AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS encoder_artifacts_with_v_dim_owner FROM provenance.v_dim d WHERE d.source_path IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_path FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE post_merge_tokens IS NOT NULL)) SELECT s.traced_slope,196.0/s.traced_slope AS ratio_196_to_slope,s.intercept,s.slope_window_breakdowns,s.is_current,s.superseded_rows,i.selected_denominator_breakdown,e.*,o.encoder_artifacts_with_v_dim_owner FROM slope s CROSS JOIN image_breakdown i CROSS JOIN encoder e CROSS JOIN owner_status o
